import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Product distribution
product_counts = df['product'].value_counts()
axes[0, 0].bar(product_counts.index, product_counts.values, color='#8B4513')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Product Distribution')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Product')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[0, 0].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 2. Size distribution
size_counts = df['size'].value_counts()
colors = {'Small': '#FFE4B5', 'Medium': '#DEB887', 'Large': '#8B4513'}
axes[0, 1].pie(size_counts.values, labels=size_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=[colors.get(x, '#DEB887') for x in size_counts.index])
axes[0, 1].set_title('Size Distribution')

# 3. Payment method distribution
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
axes[0, 2].bar(payment_counts.index, payment_counts.values, color='#6B8E23')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Payment Methods')
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Payment Method')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Count')

# 4. Customer age group distribution
age_counts = df['customer_age_group'].value_counts()
axes[1, 0].barh(age_counts.index, age_counts.values, color='#4682B4')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Customer Age Groups')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Count')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Age Group')

# 5. Total sales over time
df['hour'] = df['time'].str.split(':').str[0].astype(int)
hourly_sales = df.groupby('hour')['total'].sum()
axes[1, 1].plot(hourly_sales.index, hourly_sales.values, marker='o', 
                linewidth=2, markersize=8, color='#FF6347')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Sales by Hour')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Hour of Day')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
axes[1, 1].grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 6. Takeaway vs Dine-in
takeaway_counts = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts()
takeaway_labels = ['Takeaway' if x == 1 else 'Dine-in' for x in takeaway_counts.index]
axes[1, 2].pie(takeaway_counts.values, labels=takeaway_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%',
               colors=['#FFA500', '#32CD32'])
axes[1, 2].set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
